problemStatement.formal: Formalize the strong Nullstellensatz statement I(V(J)) = rad(J) for multivariate polynomial ideals over an algebraically closed field using Mathlib's Jacobson-ring infrastructure.
problemStatement.plain: Expose Mathlib's strong Nullstellensatz as a clean gallery proof and derive standard corollaries about weak Nullstellensatz, polynomial membership, and radical ideals.
whyMatters: Connects the factor-remainder gallery thread to a central theorem of algebraic geometry.
Shows the problem can be solved directly from Mathlib without extra axioms.
Gives future algebraic-geometry work a verified I(V(-)) and radical-ideal bridge.
